guarantees.claim: service_rejected_error is asynchronously cleared to 0 when rst_ni is low.
service_rejected_error is set to 1 on the next positive clock edge when service_rejected_error_set is high and rst_ni is high.
guarantees.cond: service_rejected_error_set high at rising edge of clk_i, rst_ni high

guarantees.claim: service_rejected_error is cleared to 0 on the next positive clock edge when service_rejected_error_set is low and service_rejected_error_clr is high, and rst_ni is high.
guarantees.cond: service_rejected_error_set low, service_rejected_error_clr high at rising edge, rst_ni high

guarantees.claim: service_rejected_error holds its previous value when neither set nor clear conditions are active and rst_ni is high.
guarantees.cond: rst_ni high, service_rejected_error_set low and service_rejected_error_clr low

assumptions.claim: service_rejected_error_set and service_rejected_error_clr inputs must be stable and glitch-free around the rising edge of clk_i.
assumptions.cond: when rst_ni high, during setup/hold window of clk_i
assumptions.risk: Glitches could cause spurious set or clear of service_rejected_error, corrupting the error flag.

uncertain_points.claim: The set-over-clear priority (service_rejected_error_set takes precedence over service_rejected_error_clr) may be unintentional or undesired.
uncertain_points.cond: when both service_rejected_error_set and service_rejected_error_clr are high at the same clock edge
uncertain_points.risk: If unintended, simultaneous set and clear could prevent error clearance, leading to persistent error state and possible denial-of-service.

uncertain_points.claim: Service_rejected_error high state impact is not locally resolved; its effect depends on other blocks that read this flag.
uncertain_points.risk: Could lock out operations, block future service requests, or cause unrecoverable error propagation if not properly handled elsewhere.

uncertain_points.claim: No local timeout or automatic clear mechanism exists for service_rejected_error; a stuck-high condition requires external intervention.
uncertain_points.cond: if external logic fails to assert service_rejected_error_clr or if the clear is blocked
uncertain_points.risk: Persistent error flag could mask subsequent errors or require a system reset to recover.
